name: baseline_protocol_v1.1
revision_reason: training-design identifiability only: with n_b=2, the two flow-lag columns were exactly identical in frozen training experiments; no 3.21 performance motivated this change
static: ordinary least squares; contemporaneous conditional regression
arx_equation_timing: For target y[t]=y[k+1], nk=0 uses u[k]; nk=1 uses u[k-1]. B lags continue backward by one minute.
arx_reparameterization: flow retains exactly one coefficient at lag target-1-n_k; G, Tamb, Ttank and Pel retain n_b in {1,2}
selection: 3.21 common-support pooled free-run RMSE primary; rank-deficient candidates are ineligible; stable candidates only when available; within 0.05 C prefer fewer parameters then lower orders; MAE, absolute Bias and segment-safe one-step residual ACF are secondary
common_evaluation_support: All models score target indices t >= 3 in every independent 3.21 segment; N_common=383.
initialization: All 3.21 free runs use the first 3 measured outputs per segment as one common start buffer; no measured output correction after scoring begins.
scaling: Output/input means and population standard deviations computed from training experiments only and applied unchanged to 3.21.
blind_test: Reader stops before first 2026-03-26 row; no performance evaluation before grey-box freeze.
